nodes.summary: DeltaNet is a linear transformer whose matrix-valued state $S_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$ is updated by the delta rule $S_t = S_{t-1} - \beta_t (S_{t-1} k_t - v_t) k_t^{\mathsf{T}} = S_{t-1} (I - \beta_t k_t k_t^{\mathsf{T}}) + \beta_t v_t k_t^{\mathsf{T}}$, with keys and values $k_t, v_t \in \mathbb{R}^d$, writing strength $\beta_t = \sigma(W_{\beta} x_t) \in (0, 1)$ and output $o_t = S_t q_t$. nodes.title: Delta-rule linear attention

nodes.summary: For a frozen pretrained weight matrix $W_0 \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times k}$ and a rank $r$, low-rank adaptation trains $B \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times r}$ and $A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times k}$ and uses the weight $W_0 + BA$: a layer input $x$ gives $h = W_0 x + BAx$. The matrix $A$ is initialised at random and $B$ at zero, so the update $BA$ starts at $0$.
nodes.title: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA)

nodes.summary: PiSSA keeps the adapter architecture of low-rank adaptation and changes its initialisation. Let $W \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$ be a pretrained weight matrix with an economy singular value decomposition $W = U S V^{\mathsf{T}}$ whose singular values $s_1 \ge s_2 \ge \dots \ge 0$ are in nonincreasing order, and let $1 \le r \le \min(m, n)$. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
